title: Defender (Banu, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Defender is a small two-seat fighter of the alien Banu in Star Citizen, flown by humans with the common controls. It mixes technology from different alien peoples and has modest room for its crew.

panels.name: Defender: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Defender's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (four tachyon cannons)
controls.text: The Defender has four tachyon cannons, energy guns, for the pilot.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (six missiles)
controls.text: The Defender carries six missiles. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: Defender: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the Defender besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Second seat
controls.text: The Defender carries a crew of two. More people on board can share the work.
controls.context: A second person on board can take over jobs such as turrets, scanning or the radio, so the pilot can concentrate on flying.
